brief_summary: Two-row horizontal bar chart on a shared 60–85 dBA axis. Row one, Gazzew Boba U4, ends at 67.7 dBA in warm-grey. Row two, Gazzew Boba U4T, ends at 81.5 dBA with the final 13.8 dB segment filled in the dusty-rose splash and bracketed as the pads-present-vs-absent gap. Footnotes flag that the two readings come from one tester on one full-keyboard rig with no published meter distance, and state the 10 dB ≈ half-perceived-loudness rule of thumb used in the body.
data_sources: https://www.clickandthock.com/tactile-switches-1/gazzew-boba-u4t — noise level '81.5dBA'; tested 'on a full keyboard, using SA, MT3, and GMK keycaps'
silent-switch-damping-deep-dive.mdx § 'What the pads buy: the U4T control' — 'That is a 13.8 dB gap. Meter distance and room are not published, so treat the absolute figures loosely'
silent-switch-damping-deep-dive.mdx § 'What the pads buy: the U4T control' — 'By the rule of thumb that a 10 dB step reads as roughly half the perceived loudness'
warnings: Source readings are single-reviewer meter values with unpublished distance/room; the viz presents them as a relative gap between two switches on one rig, not as absolute loudness.
